mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales of Goods signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the combination signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and UNRATE increases by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY decline > 10% and UNRATE increase > 0.3%
failure_condition: If HOUST YoY decline > 10% and UNRATE increase > 0.3% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% year-over-year, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in low-growth environment
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 3% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 1% and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
